codesFaq.question: How do I redeem Aniimo codes?
codesFaq.answer: Launch Aniimo in Roblox, tap the codes or settings icon on the interface, enter your code into the text field, and hit Redeem. Codes are case-sensitive.

codesFaq.question: Why do Aniimo codes expire?
codesFaq.answer: Codes are released for updates, holidays, and milestones, and typically expire after a few weeks. We test codes daily to ensure they work.

codesFaq.question: How often are new Aniimo codes released?
codesFaq.answer: Developers release new codes during major patches, server milestones, or like count goals. Check back regularly!

codesFaq.question: Are Aniimo codes free?
codesFaq.answer: Yes, all active promo codes are 100% free for in-game gems, coins, and boosters.
